intro: Choose a project to manage its requests, activity and settings.
requests_help: Review and track this project’s requests.
scoped: Only this project’s records appear here.
unavailable_help: Try another project or return to the project list.
load_error: Could not load data. You can retry.
save_error: Could not save. Your changes are preserved.
leave: You have unsaved changes. Leave this page?
pending: Saving. Wait for it to finish.
connect_needed: Square is not connected for this project.
update_order: Update this work order? A status change may notify the customer.
settings_help: Project details, customer access and request link.
access_help: Link an existing user account to this project. Create accounts in the existing identity system.
clear: No pending website requests. Manage daily work from the project menu.
order_help: Open customer jobs, add measurements and notes, update status or print a ticket.
catalog_help: Manage product visibility, variations and purchase links.
commerce_help: Check delivery regions, shipping prices and sales readiness.
demo_mode: Sample data. No real records are created.
background_paused: Unsaved changes are preserved; automatic refresh is waiting.
workspaces_help: Review new applications, prepare drafts and inspect prepared work.
stock_help: Update Square stock quantities. Manage website placement in the catalog above.
no_stock: No variants with stock tracking enabled.
intake_help: Open the customer repair form; submissions arrive in work orders.
All selected variations are sold out: All selected variations are sold out
